purpose: Fixture-specific, read-only inspection of four native Microsoft PowerPoint macro-enabled and legacy derivatives containing a harmless, manually callable VBA procedure.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft PowerPoint UI and native VBE
provenance.source: One title slide was authored in native PowerPoint. Standard Module1 contains the final passive FixtureNoOp procedure. The project was saved through native PowerPoint as PPTM, POTM, PPSM and legacy PPT.
provenance.macro_storage: Standard Module1 in the current presentation/template/show; no Personal Macro Workbook, add-in, event module or automatic entry point was used.
provenance.recorded_vba_source: Option Explicit, then Public Sub FixtureNoOp with a local String variable assigned the PPT_MACRO_005 marker; the procedure is never called by the fixture.

scope_and_limits.semantic_limit: The fixtures prove native container storage, marker preservation, and inert VBA source decoding. They do not execute VBA, certify template instantiation or slideshow-runtime behavior, or claim complete legacy PPT feature parity.
scope_and_limits.legacy_vba_reader_limit: The strict litchi-ppt VBA reader exposes valid VBAInfo and persisted-storage metadata but rejects the native legacy outer payload with `PowerPoint(Corrupted("invalid ExOleObjStg zlib payload: incomplete deflate stream"))`. A separate temporary read-only probe that appended an empty final raw-deflate block recovered the declared 8192-byte inner CFB and the same Module1 source; this permissive probe is evidence only and is not a library-reader pass.

module.name: Module1
module.source_text:
Attribute VB_Name = "Module1"
Option Explicit

Public Sub FixtureNoOp()
    Dim fixtureMarker As String
    fixtureMarker = "PPT_MACRO_005"
    
End Sub

source_decoded_from: ppt/VbaProjectStg after bounded temporary raw-deflate recovery
vba_source.source_behavior: FixtureNoOp only assigns the local fixtureMarker variable. It has no workbook/presentation mutation, no event procedure and no automatic entry point; it was not run or compiled deliberately.

macro_security_validation.scope: Root agent reopened each final file through native PowerPoint File Open with macros disabled. No Trust Center or security setting was changed.

validation_methods: SHA-256 and byte size were computed from all four closed final fixture byte streams.
file identified pptm, potm and ppsm as Microsoft PowerPoint 2007+ and ppt as a CFB/OLE Microsoft Macintosh PowerPoint document.
unzip -t passed for all three OPC packages; each contained 38 members.
Python ZipFile/ElementTree inspection parsed package XML and relationships, confirmed the macro-enabled main content type for each extension, and confirmed the internal rId7 VBA relationship target.
The litchi-pptx reader opened all three OPC packages, exposed one slide with the expected text and decoded the embedded MS-OVBA project and Module1 source without execution.

The litchi-ppt reader and dump_ppt_structure opened the legacy CFB, recovered the slide marker and exposed VBAInfo/VbaProjectStg metadata. Its strict bounded VBA payload decoder recorded the incomplete-deflate result above.

A temporary probe outside the repository recovered the native legacy raw-deflate payload into an 8192-byte inner CFB and decoded the same inert Module1 source; this probe made no repository or library changes.
Root Computer Use observations record exact-file PowerPoint reopen with Disable Macros selected, no repair prompt, and the one-slide marker visible for all four final files.
